phrases.en: I am here to help you.
phrases.phonetic: Ai am jir tu jelp iu.

phrases.en: Let me help you stand up.
phrases.phonetic: Let mi jelp iu stand ap.

phrases.en: It is time for your medicine.
phrases.phonetic: It is taim for ior medesin.

phrases.en: Please call me if you need help.
phrases.es: Llámame si necesitas ayuda, por favor.
phrases.phonetic: Plis col mi if iu nid jelp.

phrases.en: Let's go for a short walk.
phrases.es: Vamos a dar un paseo corto.
phrases.phonetic: Lets go for a short uok.

phrases.en: I don't speak English very well.
phrases.phonetic: Ai dont spik inglish veri uel.

phrases.en: Can you speak more slowly, please?
phrases.phonetic: Can iu spik mor slouli, plis?
